headlines.title: Iranians’ frustrations grow as Tehran, under U.S. pressure, imposes austerity

headlines.title: SE. Asia's AI drive faces hurdles
headlines.summary: Southeast Asia's ambition to become a global AI hub is facing setbacks from new United States restrictions on advanced AI chip exports and plans to curb overseas data center construction, threatening the region's fast-growing data center and technology sectors, analysts say.

headlines.title: Mideast on edge of escalation
